question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"impact."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Impact"** refers to the effect or influence of something on something else. (परिणाम या प्रभाव) • **Example**:* I hope this anti-smoking campaign will make an **impact**__ on young people.* • The word **"outcome"** could also work in this context, but "impact" is a more precise and appropriate choice. • The correct answer is Option 4. • Correct passage: .......Seasonal winds can have a significant** **__**impact**__ on agriculture, particularly in regions where rainfall is limited.......... [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Opportunity"** refers to a favorable situation or chance for advancement or progress. (अवसर, सुअवसर, मौक़ा; उपयुक्त, अवसरानुकूल सि्‍थति या समय) • **"Blame" r**efers to assigning responsibility for a fault or wrongdoing. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ग़लती का ज़िम्‍मेदार या दोषी ठहराना) • **"Outcome"** means the result or effect of an action or an event. (किसी क्रिया या घटना का परिणाम या प्रभाव) 4a:Tc91, The correct answer is **"disrupt."**
